description: Escalation-as-form: a 'lyrical' track with no lyrics and a 'doom' track that accelerates. Three acts (F -> Eb minor -> F), tempo stepping 103.4 -> 129.2 -> 136 BPM at the act boundaries, each act peaking louder than the last, cliffs punishing each peak, and a finale that ends at maximum volume with no fade - cut off mid-sentence.
name: lyrical_doom

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Quietest window in the track (-20.9dB at 0:05). F root already dominant in the chroma. Short - 42 seconds - then the build starts.

sections.name: Act I (F, slow build)
sections.notes: Slow climb, RMS -13.1 to -9.5 per 30s. F major/minor ambiguity on a static root - both thirds in the chroma. Slowest tempo block (per-minute 103.4, unconfirmed).

sections.name: Peak A + first cliff
sections.notes: Loudest so far (-6.0dB at 3:20), then an 11.1dB cliff in 10 seconds (-6.0 to -17.1dB by 3:30) with the centroid collapsing to 1181Hz. The cliff IS the section break.

sections.name: Act II (Eb minor)
sections.notes: The long middle: whole-step modulation to Eb minor at the highest key confidence in the track (0.71-0.84). Rebuild -12.3 to -8.0 per 30s; tempo steps to 129.2 at 4:00 and 136 at 6:00. Second peak -5.9dB at 7:05.

sections.name: Hinge
sections.notes: Seven seconds, the darkest window in the track (centroid 1043Hz, rolloff 1880Hz). The key flips D# maj -> F min across it. Darken first, then turn - a seam, not a transition.

sections.name: Act III (F returns)
sections.notes: F minor returns; rebuild from -13.4 to -9.2. Brightest sustained timbre in the track (centroid ~3000Hz). Steady 136 BPM. No new tricks - the return itself is the section.

sections.name: Finale (at maximum)
sections.notes: One last dropout (-17.4dB at 10:00), then the loudest sustained run in the track: -7.8dB for 10:30-11:00, -5.0dB for 11:00-11:12, loudest window -4.5dB at 11:05, master at 0.0dBFS. No fade, no pullback, no resolution. Cut off at full volume.

status: analyzed — 7 sections from features JSON (detector boundaries at 0:42/3:09/3:58/7:15/7:22/10:12, 5s RMS, 5s spectral, 30s key), 2026-11-06
